source_citation: Mondo et al. (2021), Plants 10:1412, DOI 10.3390/plants10071412
source_excerpt: Yam (Dioscorea spp.) species are predominantly dioecious, with male and female flowers borne on separate individuals. Cross-pollination is, therefore, essential for gene flow among and within yam species to achieve breeding objectives.
